name: decision-science-skills
description: Decision discipline under uncertainty: pre-mortem (with the counsel rail), tabletop wargaming and no-win drills under full exercise control, weak-signal navigation with cue-graded confidence, Bayesian updating via natural frequencies, reference-class forecasting, competing hypotheses analysis, minority-report dissent capture, the Rashomon-effect protocol for conflicting recollections, and The Challenger.
